dedupe_keys.name: simone commercial simulation and optimisation software for gas transmission and distribution pipeline networks liwacom

description: SIMONE is commercial software for simulating and optimising the flow of natural gas and other gaseous fluids in large pipeline networks, a common product of LIWACOM Informationstechnik and the SIMONE Research Group developed over almost three decades. The LIWACOM site describes it as optimised for transmission and distribution systems and covering system design, real-time operation, leak detection and location, gas quality reconstruction for billing, compressor fuel optimisation and capacity determination. A model has two parts: a Network describing the topology and parameters of pipeline segments, valves, compressor stations with an optional detailed compressor model, storages, resistances and nodes, and a Scenario setting the steady or transient simulation or state estimation task, times, initial and boundary conditions. It tracks gas composition and pipeline inspection gauges, estimates real-time states, runs on a single kernel for Windows, Unix and Linux with client-server and multi-user support, and has a Java GUI and the SIMONE API for links to SCADA, GIS and databases. The site states field use on several hundred thousand kilometres of pipelines and statutory approval for energy billing. Access is by commercial licence, with fact sheets available online; the site also reports that LIWACOM has joined Energy Exemplar. Caveats: performance claims are the vendor's own, and prices and licence terms are not published. Simulation uses are transient gas network hydraulics, security of supply and capacity studies, and operational digital twins. Related records: model-gasnetsim is an open alternative.
